mapper.select: select l.id, l.sort_order as "order", l.name, l.arabic from realdb.letters l where l.is_active = 1 order by l.sort_order

select l.id, l.sort_order as "order", l.name, l.arabic, l.arabic_name as "arabicName", l.sound, l.makhraj, l.form_isolated as "formIsolated", l.form_initial as "formInitial", l.form_medial as "formMedial", l.form_final as "formFinal", l.example_arabic as "exampleArabic", l.example_translit as "exampleTranslit", l.example_meaning as "exampleMeaning", t.instructions as "traceInstructions", coalesce(tf.code, 'isolated') as "traceForm", w.instructions as "writeInstructions", coalesce(wf.code, 'isolated') as "writeForm", li.id as "listenId", li.instructions as "listenInstructions", li.audio_url as "listenAudioUrl", r.instructions as "repeatInstructions", r.audio_url as "repeatAudioUrl" from realdb.letters l left join realdb.trace t on t.letter_id = l.id and t.is_active = 1 left join realdb.form tf on tf.id = t.form_id left join realdb.writing w on w.letter_id = l.id and w.is_active = 1 left join realdb.form wf on wf.id = w.form_id left join realdb.listen li on li.letter_id = l.id and li.is_active = 1 left join realdb.repeat r on r.letter_id = l.id and r.is_active = 1 where l.id = #{id} and l.is_active = 1

select l.id, l.sort_order as "order", l.name, l.arabic from realdb.listen_distractor d join realdb.letters l on l.id = d.distractor_letter_id where d.listen_id = #{listenId} and d.is_active = 1 and l.is_active = 1 order by l.sort_order
select j.id, j.instructions from realdb.joining j where j.letter_id = #{letterId} and j.is_active = 1
select d.id, d.text, d.features, d.audio_url as "audioUrl" from realdb.drill d where d.joining_id = #{joiningId} and d.is_active = 1 order by d.sort_order
